articles.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
articles.snippet: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress
articles.snippet: Separate reports from Axios and CBS suggest some positive movement in U.S.-Iran negotiations.

articles.title: Bullish, Alpaca, Apex Fintech and DriveWealth form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: European stablecoin issuer Qivalis sees transformation of global trade finance
articles.snippet: Jan-Oliver Sell, the CEO and founder of Qivalis, said the entire trade finance supply chain is moving into stablecoins.

articles.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
articles.snippet: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.
